title: The 10 Best Utility Knives
subtitle: Retractable, folding and flip-open utility knives and box cutters, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A utility knife takes cheap replaceable blades for cutting boxes, carpet, drywall and rope. We ranked 10 best-sellers from WORKPRO, Klein, Milwaukee, DEWALT, REXBETI and others on rating, review volume and features (quick blade changes, blade storage, spare blades and a metal body). They're inexpensive enough that many people keep one in every drawer and toolbox.

changelog.note: Page published with 10 ranked picks and 1 tool to avoid.

products.name: WORKPRO Premium Utility Knife, Retractable All-Metal Heavy Duty Box Cutter, Quick Change, with 10 Extra Blades
products.verdict: The best-selling and among the best-rated knives here: an aluminum retractable knife with three blade positions, quick blade changes and 10 spare blades, for under $10.
products.best_for: Anyone who needs one solid box cutter for packages, carpet and drywall.
products.skip_if: You want a folding knife for your pocket.

products.name: M MEEPO 4-Pack Folding Utility Knife Box Cutters with 10 Blades
products.verdict: Four colorful folding box cutters and 10 spare blades for about the price of one knife, so there's one in every drawer and car.
products.best_for: Households and warehouses that lose box cutters.
products.skip_if: You want a premium knife that lasts years.

products.name: Klein Tools 44306 FLICKBLADE 2-in-1 Folding Utility Knife and Scraper with Built-In Blade Storage

specs.extras: Converts to a scraper, aluminum body

products.verdict: A Klein folding knife that converts into a scraper, with two lock positions (angled and straight), an aluminum body and a slot that holds a spare blade.
products.best_for: Electricians and remodelers who want a knife and scraper in one.
products.skip_if: You want a cheaper basic box cutter.

products.name: REXBETI Box Cutter 2-Pack, Utility Knife with Blade Storage, 18 Blades
products.verdict: A two-knife set (one retractable, one folding) with built-in blade storage, quick blade changes and 18 blackened SK5 blades.
products.best_for: Anyone who wants two styles and enough blades for a year.

products.name: Milwaukee Fastback Folding Utility Knife with Blade Storage (48-22-1502)

specs.extras: Gut hook, wire stripper to 10 AWG, blade storage, belt clip

products.verdict: Milwaukee's Fastback flips open with one hand and adds a gut hook for cutting string and a 10-gauge wire stripper, plus storage for spare blades and tool-free blade changes.
products.best_for: Trades who want one-handed opening and extras built in.
products.skip_if: You need spare blades in the box; the listing doesn't list any.

products.name: Amazon Basics Folding Utility Knife Box Cutter with Back-Lock, Aluminum Handle
products.verdict: The cheapest folding knife here: an aluminum lock-back knife that takes standard blades with quick changes.
products.best_for: A cheap pocket knife for boxes and tape.

products.name: DEWALT Push and Flip Folding Utility Knife (DWHT10995)
products.verdict: A DEWALT knife that opens one-handed with a push and flip, with a secure blade lock and a quick-change lever.
products.best_for: DEWALT fans who want a compact, one-handed knife.
products.skip_if: You want blade storage in the handle.

products.name: INTERNET'S BEST Premium Utility Knife Set, Retractable Box Cutter with Rubber Handle
products.verdict: The most-reviewed knife set here, with 14,324 reviews: retractable knives with rubber grips, quick blade changes and a pouch of five spare blades.
products.best_for: Homes and offices that want a few comfortable knives.

products.name: Klein Tools 44304 Folding FLICKBLADE Utility Knife with Removable Impact Driver

specs.extras: Removable impact-rated 1/4 in nut driver and #2 Phillips bit

products.verdict: A Klein folding knife with a detachable impact-rated 1/4-inch nut driver and #2 Phillips bit, so you can cut and drive with one tool.
products.best_for: Electricians and installers who want a driver bit on their knife.

products.name: Milwaukee FASTBACK Compact Flip Utility Knife
products.verdict: A smaller Fastback that rates 4.8 stars and sells over 2,000 a month. The listing has no bullets, so check the photos for details.
products.best_for: Anyone who wants a pocket-size Fastback.
products.skip_if: You want features listed; this listing has none.

avoid.name: Milwaukee FASTBACK Folding Utility Knife w/Blade Multifunctionality, Red-black
avoid.flag: Sold as a utility knife; bullets describe a pocket knife
avoid.verdict: The title says utility knife, but the listing describes a folding pocket knife with a fixed tanto blade and screwdriver bits, not one that takes replaceable utility blades.
reasons: The bullets describe a 'Stainless Steel Blade, partially Serrated' and a 'Stays Sharp Tanto Blade': a fixed pocket-knife blade, not the snap-in utility blades shoppers searching for a utility knife expect.
Nothing in the listing mentions blade changes or spare blades, so when it dulls you sharpen it rather than swap a blade.
If you want a Milwaukee utility knife, the Fastback 48-22-1502 has tool-free blade changes and blade storage for less.

buyers_guide.a: Retractable knives slide the blade back into the handle and are safest in a toolbox. Folding knives close like a pocket knife and ride on a belt clip. Flip-open knives like Milwaukee's Fastback and DEWALT's push-and-flip open with one hand.
Nearly all of these take the standard trapezoid utility blade sold everywhere. Buy blades in bulk; a sharp blade is safer because you push less.
It saves hunting for a spare on a ladder. The Klein 44306, REXBETI set and Milwaukee 48-22-1502 store blades in the handle.
Aluminum bodies like the WORKPRO and Amazon Basics folding knife survive drops and look better longer. Plastic knives are fine for a junk drawer.

buyers_guide.q: Is a utility knife the same as a pocket knife?
buyers_guide.a: No. A utility knife takes cheap replaceable blades you swap when dull. A pocket knife has a fixed blade you sharpen. For boxes, carpet and drywall, a utility knife is easier to keep sharp.
